principles.text: Do not get bearish too early and do not short too early; an uptrend like this is more likely to end in a euphoric climax run than a quiet roll-over.
Trim less in the early stage of an uptrend; trust the trend and hold larger positions while the longs keep pushing away from your stop, then sell more into strength only after a 60%+ move.
Best entries come when daily and weekly EMAs converge tightly together - a compression that precedes expansion (the start of a trend).
Sell some into strength at unfilled gaps and prior-high resistance (e.g. Tesla's 470 gap); trail the rest, tightening the trail timeframe (15/30/60-min 9 EMA) if worried about market extension.
Stay away from social media / news feeds during the week to avoid FOMO; review tweets only on weekends to check whether you already lined up with the right names.

There is no single right place to sell; choose a stop/back-stop rule (prior-day low, unfilled gap, 9 EMA) before the trade based on your turnover style, then review whether the rule itself can be improved.
Coming out of a losing streak, trade smaller (0.2-0.3% risk), take only the very best/tight entries, and rebuild confidence until two-to-three positions are working and the broad market participates.
